column2: Conditions on Retention and Disposal of Non-Residential Private Property

column1: Buying a flat from HDB Buying a resale Plus or Prime flat Buying a resale unclassified/ Standard flat with CPF housing grant(s) Applying for a housing loan from HDB
column2: You can own or have an interest in up to 1 non-residential property at the time of HFE letter application, regardless of your share of ownership. If the applicants and occupiers own the same non-residential property, the household is considered as owning 1 non-residential property. If you own or have an interest in more than 1 non-residential property, you must dispose of the interest in the other non-residential properties at least 30 months before your HFE letter application, from the legal completion date [8] .

column1: Buying a non-subsidised resale unclassified/ Standard flat with or without Proximity Housing Grant
column2: No restriction on the number of non-residential properties.

column1: Buying a short-lease 2-room Flexi flat or Community Care Apartment from HDB (see Seniors page)
column2: If you own or have an interest in more than 1 non-residential property at the time of HFE letter application, you must dispose of the interest in the other non-residential properties, based on the legal completion of the disposal, within 6 months of completing your flat purchase [9] .
